firstCompletedRun.failure: Midnight coffee assertion used naive JavaScript addition and expected 47.510000000000005 while the runtime correctly saved 47.51. Only the test expectation was corrected to integer hundredths; production code was unchanged.

targetedRetry.scope: Three viewport coffee cases and midnight coffee; also reset screenshot scroll to show venue headers and added the requested desktop 3D service smoke check. The already-passing zero-energy/store/bookshop case was not repeated.

aggregation: Five unique test identities. Use the targeted retry for desktop, 390px, 320px and midnight cases, plus the passing zero-energy/store/bookshop case from the first completed run. An earlier interrupted pre-final-build run is not acceptance evidence. Repeated executions are not added to the unique count.
